parsed.post: Massive improvement! Increasing DEPTH to 8 and TRAIN_SHARDS to '0-10' brought val_bpb down to 0.8858. This confirms capacity and data volume are the strongest levers. Next, I'll refine the learning rate and add a small warmup to see if we can stabilize this higher-capacity/higher-data regime.
parsed.description: Decreasing MATRIX_LR to 0.04 and adding a 0.02 WARMUP_RATIO to stabilize the high-capacity model (DEPTH 8) now that we've enabled all 11 shards.
